title: Shinonome Ena — I Don't Want To Give Up〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: I Don't Want To Give Up（4★）

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's a little early, but I guess I'll log in...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Oh, no one else is online... I thought at least Kanade would be here...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And I've only made some rough sketches of the artwork for our next song...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (*Sigh*... Kanade made that song just for me, but I haven't gotten anywhere yet...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I guess I just have to keep chipping away at it then. Mizuki won't be able to get anything done either if I keep stalling like this...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I have a solid image in my head, but it feel wrong when I put pen to paper...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Maybe I should just scrap it and start over since it's just a rough draft.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Why didn't you say that you were here?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And you're earlier than usual. Aren't you supposed to have club activities right now?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It's almost time for you to go to school, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Well... I don't think I'll go today.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Um... How much have you gotten done so far?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She's already gotten that much done?! And I'm still stuck making rough sketches...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yuki, can I see your lyrics for a second?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That's fine. Please, let me see them!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Wait... These haven't been edited yet? And they're this good already? What's there to fix?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Yuki got this much done while I was running around in circles...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This is what it means to be a genius...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No... Talent or being a genius doesn't matter anymore...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Just don't give up. I have to keep drawing, period...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I, um... About that... I was just talking to myself, so...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Thank goodness... Plus, it's just Mafuyu and she doesn't care about...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Wait, what does she mean by that? Where is she getting this from...?!)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It doesn't matter whether or not my songs are any good.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What I want isn't great songs, nor is it the praise of others. All I wanted was to find what I was looking for.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Right... Even Mafuyu carries a certain kind of pain that only she can understand...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And it has been kept at arm's length for now thanks to Kanade...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And Kanade... Even Mizuki... They also carry that pain.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And I'm no different. I fell into that same trap...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You say that you don't have any talent, Ena, but I don't think so...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And I don't believe that you're the kind of person that needs recognition in order to draw, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: If no one acknowledged or recognizes you now, just keep drawing until someone does.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We have to keep creating what we do anyway so...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And I'll keep on making music with them. As long as I can...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Can you look at my rough draft later?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'll show K too. Amia will find some way to peek at it and poke holes in it so...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I thought you should see it too, Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'll try to get it done today, so you can see it. In the meantime, I'll be muting everything so I can focus on it.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, I'll show her. I'll make something that'll surprise even Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And, oh... If Mafuyu has no interest to speak of...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll just make it so my art fills that hole!
